definition: no longer fresh and not safe to eat
description: On a sunny park lawn, a young woman with a ponytail, in a blue crop top and white shorts, kneels on a grey picnic rug and holds open the lid of a cool box full of mouldy, spoiled flatbread, pulling back and grimacing. Beside her a young man in a cream t-shirt turns away and covers his nose. A yellow Labrador gets up behind them and walks off. At the end she pushes the lid of the box down. Empty plates, steel mugs and a puddle of spilled brown liquid lie on the rug.

de.answer: Das Essen in der Kiste ist verdorben.
de.question: Wie ist das Essen?
